title: Undo/redo as appended inverse events
goal: Undo and redo append inverse transactions (never remove events), restore the selection and group like users expect.
scope: Session-local history of the own actor’s events; undo event = concrete inverse ops + u:<id>; redo = inverse of the undo
Mod+Z, Shift+Mod+Z, Ctrl+Y keydown plus historyUndo/historyRedo beforeinput
Flush the pending coalesced event first; restore the selection from before the original event
After reopen the stack is empty (documented)
out_of_scope: Gesture undo on mobile if no event is emitted (R2)

rules.rule: Append-only: undo never deletes or rewrites ledger lines.

criteria: Fuzz with undo/redo weight on all targets: undo-all returns to the load hash, redo-all to the final hash, I1–I8 hold.
A typed sentence undoes word by word; formatting and paragraph splits are separate steps.
The selection after undo/redo equals the selection before the original event.
The ledger line count only grows during undo/redo.
Shortcuts work on all 5 targets (hardware keyboard on simulator/emulator).
acceptance.critic: Differential vs B2 grouping plus criteria.
